summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Maryland.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Atkin v. Kansas, 191 U. S. 207; Heim v. Mc*635Call, 239 U. S., ante, p. 175; Crane v. New York, 239 U. S., ante, p. 195.
